senses.gloss: (variously corrupted) pr. n. pl. Puteoli, a great sea-town of Italy.
units: <cite ref="Makkot 24a:33">Macc. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>שמעו קול המונה של רומי מפ׳ ברחוק מאה וכ׳</he> (ed. <he>בבל מפלטיה</he>, margin. vers. <he>מפטילוס</he>; Ms. M. <he>מפלטוס</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) they heard the din of the city of Rome (on travelling) from P., at a distance of one hundred and seventy miles; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah, Petichta 24">Lam. R. to V, 18</cite> <cite ref="Q00194"><he>פוטליילוס</he></cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 43:12">Sifré Deut. 43</cite> <he>של מפטילון</he> (v. <cite ref="E00606"><he>הֶמְיָיה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 278">Yalk. Is. 278</cite> <he>מפניליאוס</he>. [The termination <he>־</he><he>וס</he> in the above forms corresponds to the accus. -ους, -os.]
